name: 🚀 Fly to SPACE! [BACK!]
desc:
RACE TO THE TOP!

Use code "THANKYOU_FORPLAYING" for a free prize!
👍 LIKE GOAL: 200,000 LIKES! 

How to Play:
🚀 Collect orbs to charge up and gain flight!
🐼 Collect various pets to help you on your journey!
🌍 Launch off from Earth and fly through space, galaxy and different dimensions!
🏆 Get the highest distance record and race against your friends!

❤️ Made by the creators of the 2022 hit game "Fly Race"!
